svg.title: C10-M06-F2: x86-64 registers a reverse engineer tracks
svg.desc: The main x86-64 registers with their roles - return value, arguments, stack, instruction pointer and flags.
svg.text: C10-M06-F2 x86-64 registers a reverse engineer tracks
rax : return value / syscall number rsp : stack pointer
rdi,rsi,rdx,rcx,r8,r9 : args (System V) rbp : frame pointer
rip : next instruction (not writable) rflags : zero/sign/carry/overflow
(Windows x64 args: rcx, rdx, r8, r9)
Figure C10-M06-F2. Key x86-64 registers and their conventional roles [C10-M06-R3].
